snippet.title: Mandew vs the Upside Down Machine Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A direct sequel to Mandew vs the Colorless Curse, Mandew is back again to reclaim the city of Salsa from the creator of the Upside Down Machine, a device capable of... well... turning things upside down!

EDIT: Game has been released, you can play it here: http://www.suitgames.com/mandew3

http://www.suitgames.com
You can follow Syaxamaphone, the creator of this game at @SyaxAttack
